title: Perform String Shifts
description: Perform a series of left and right shifts on a string and return the final string.
pseudocode:
1. totalShift = 0
2. for shift in shifts:
3.   if shift[0] == 0: totalShift -= shift[1]
4.   else: totalShift += shift[1]
5. totalShift %= n
6. result = s.slice(-totalShift) + s.slice(0, -totalShift)

steps.note: Initialize totalShift to track net movement.
Perform final shift: Move last 1 char to the front.
